required_calibration_route: range FFT over adc_cube[0:200] for all 8 channels
range-only channel-summed robust energy and local range-bin peaks
freeze range bins, weights, selection, beta, phase convention before frame 200
required_test_route: feed frozen observations and test-only ADXL preintegration to matched Kalman
no test-side range detection, channel-weight fit, angle, MUSIC, ML, or beta refit

beta.structural_relation: phase is proportional to q*cos(theta); structural beta is approximately 1/abs(cos(theta))

q_proxy_fit.reason: q_proxy is truth/q_true*cos(15 degrees), stored under truth, and conversion to structural beta needs external 15-degree information

adxl_regressed_slope.required_scale: independent ADXL scale and signed phase convention

channel_semantics.reason: all target, static scatterer, and multipath contributions project into all 8 channels; PLL is shared per physical TX

blockers: all-channel combination weights and phase convention
observable beta definition and abstention rules
matched phase unwrap and measurement variance equations
